buildCmd: cd web && npm run build && cp dist/assets/index-*.css dist/ds.css

dtsPropsFor.GridSkeleton:
/** What is loading, for a screen reader. The skeleton itself is 12 grey tiles in the grid's own shape. */
  label: string;
dtsPropsFor.FirstRun:
/** Upload, the one way in a click reaches from an empty library. The lit bench of three example parts beside it needs WebGL and is decoration. */
  onUpload: () => void;
dtsPropsFor.Crash: /* No props. The page the app shows when a render throws: the frame without its places, one Headline, one sentence that nothing on disk was touched, and Reload. */
